worked: Head of household, 42, wages 40,000: head of household column of the table; tax on Schedule A (single and head of household share it). No dependent exemption is modelled (checks carry no dependents). Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 40,000.00 = 40,000.00. Federal taxable income = 40,000.00 - standard deduction 23,625.00 = 16,375.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 40,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 40,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 40,000.00. Schedule SB: no subtraction applies; line 50 0.00. Form 1 line 6 0.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 40,000.00 - 0.00 = 40,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 40,000 to less than 40,500, column Head of a household: 12,859.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 40,000 / 40,500 / 11,076 / 22,729 / 6,618 / 12,859). Line 9 = 40,000.00 - 12,859.00 = 27,141.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 0 x 250 = 0.00; line 10c 700.00. Line 11 taxable income = 27,141.00 - 700.00 = 26,441.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule A (single and head of household) as numbers: 3.5% x 14,680.00 = 513.80 + 4.4% x 11,761.00 = 517.484; total 1,031.284, rounded once to 1,031.28. The Tax Table row 26,400 to 26,500 (PDF page 39) gives 1,032; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 1,031.28.
